submissions.description: Persistence baseline: every predicted snapshot is a copy of the input snapshot.
U-Net built from ConvNeXt blocks with large 7x7 depthwise convolutions.
Full-resolution CNN whose dilated convolutions (1-2-4-8) give it a wide receptive field.
Factorized Fourier neural operator: separate 1D spectral filters per axis in a deep residual stack.
Fourier neural operator: global convolutions through learned filters on the lowest Fourier modes.
Encodes each frame into coarse tokens and attends over the last 4 frames before decoding the next one (TF-Enc).
Graph network passing messages between neighbouring grid nodes (the GraphCast family).
U-Net with residual blocks, GroupNorm and FiLM conditioning on Re and dt (PDE-Arena style).
Local patch CNN fed the current and previous frame, blended across overlapping patches, then projected to be divergence-free.
Coarse FNO for global coupling plus local patch CNNs refined over 2 Schwarz sweeps, then projected to be divergence-free.
Classic U-Net with strided convolutions and the input scalars injected at the bottleneck.
U-shaped neural operator: a U-Net whose layers are Fourier operators that change resolution between levels.
Vision transformer with global attention over 2x2 patches and adaLN conditioning on Re and dt.
